name: death

phase_0.boundary_condition: The event horizon of the terminal state where all temporal sequences terminate.

VINIT.justification: The state of zero entropy and zero information before the emergence of a distinct system.

TANCH.justification: The absolute boundary of the system where no further work or transformation is possible.

AFWD.justification: The forward movement of a system maintaining its internal order against external decay.

AREV.justification: The programmed reversal of structural integrity leading toward dissolution.

CLINK.justification: The chaining of individual life cycles to maintain the continuity of the species.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-referential blueprint that identifies the organism as itself across time.

FSPLIT.chosen_element: Bifurcation of the soul and body
FSPLIT.justification: The separation of the informational pattern from the material substrate.

FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of the individual identity into the collective unconscious or cosmic background.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative state of active metabolism and information processing.

EVALF.justification: The negative state where metabolic processes have ceased.

ENGAGR.justification: The paradice where cells from a deceased organism reorganize into new autonomous structures like anthrobots.

IFIX.justification: The permanent and irreversible record of the existence of the system in the cosmic history.

phase_2.split_element: Bifurcation of the soul and body

phase_3.void_description: The unmanifested state before the inception of the life cycle.
phase_3.true_description: The state of active existence and functional integrity.
phase_3.false_description: The state of cessation and structural breakdown.
phase_3.both_description: The liminal state where biological components exhibit emergent agency post-mortem.

steps.domain_action: The emergence of a discrete biological entity from the cosmic background.
The establishment of the genetic identity and self-recognition of the organism.
The growth and development phase toward maximum complexity.
The interaction with other entities to form complex social and biological chains.
The onset of the terminal crisis where the system must choose between persistence and decay.
The successful maintenance of homeostasis despite environmental pressure.
The recording of the life experience into the permanent memory of the species.
The return to a stable state of being after the crisis.
The inevitable decline of metabolic efficiency and the onset of senescence.
The final separation of the informational essence from the physical form.
The cessation of all standard biological functions and the onset of decay.
The transition into the third state where cellular components reorganize into xenobots.
The ultimate reintegration of all components into the cosmic entropy pool.
The final fixation of the entity's history into the irreversible timeline of the universe.
The closure of the individual timeline within the terminal anchor of the cosmos.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The evolutionary process translating environmental pressures into biological adaptations.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Chemical signaling and neural pathways within the organism.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The epigenetic and genetic storage of ancestral and individual experiences.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The circadian rhythms and biological clocks governing the timing of life stages.
phase_5.alfs_store: The universal laws of thermodynamics and the conservation of information.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The dissipation of heat and the consumption of free energy.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: A highly ordered state of low entropy and high potential.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: A state of maximum entropy where information is preserved only as a static record.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The local increase in entropy is balanced by the permanent fixation of information in the cosmic record.
